about.title: Welcome to JFT
about.text:
Jzerat Alfhood Technical Services L.L.C. is an electromechanical engineering company in the UAE. We deliver integrated MEP, ELV and ICT systems, with value-focused design and expert supervision from first concept to handover.

We work with developers, consultants and main contractors on residential, commercial, industrial, retail and educational buildings.

banner.title: Quality Policy
banner.subtitle: Doing it right the first time

quality.intro: JFT is committed to delivering work that meets the specification, the standards that apply and the client’s expectations.
quality.statement: We plan each job carefully, use approved materials and qualified people, and check our work before moving on. When something is not right, we fix it quickly and learn from it.
points: Plan each job with a clear scope and programme
Use approved materials and qualified technicians
Inspect and test work before each stage is closed
Record test results and hand them over with the project
Listen to client feedback and correct problems quickly

safety.intro: The health and safety of our people, our clients and the public comes before programme or profit.
safety.statement: We assess risks before work starts, train our crews, and give them the right equipment. Anyone can stop work that looks unsafe.
points: Risk assessments and permits to work before starting
Trained crews with the right protective equipment
Safe handling of tools, electricity and work at height
Reporting and learning from incidents and near misses
Clear site rules for staff and visitors

environmental.intro: JFT works to limit the impact of its activities on the environment.
environmental.statement: We reduce waste, handle materials responsibly and choose efficient equipment wherever the project allows.
points: Reduce waste and recycle packaging and offcuts
Dispose of refrigerants, oils and materials responsibly
Keep sites clean and protect nearby areas

banner.title: Sustainability Policy
banner.subtitle: Building services for the long term

sustainability.intro: JFT designs and maintains systems that save energy and water and last longer.
sustainability.statement: We recommend efficient equipment, plan maintenance to extend equipment life, and review our own practices regularly.
points: Design systems that lower energy and water use
Plan maintenance to extend equipment life
Support local suppliers and skilled jobs
